description_en: Creates an Elastic Accelerated Computing Instance (EAIS) with a notebook deployed
description_zh: 创建一个部署了notebook的弹性加速计算实例
kebab_example: aliyun eais create-eai-jupyter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --eais-type eais.ei-a6.2xlarge --vswitch-id vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000 --security-group-id sg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEaiJupyter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides. For a list of the latest Alibaba Cloud regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the EAIS instance. This parameter can only be set to eais.ei-a6.2xlarge
parameters.help_zh: EAIS实例的规格，仅支持设置为eais.ei-a6.2xlarge
parameters.name: eais_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs.

The number of available IP addresses in the vSwitch CIDR block determines the maximum number of EAIS instances that can be created in the vSwitch. Plan your CIDR block settings in advance
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的虚拟交换机ID。

交换机网段内IP的个数决定了该交换机最大可支持创建的EAIS实例个数，请务必提前规划好网段设置
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数，保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为1~128位。格式要求：[0-9a-zA-Z]，以及下划线（_），不能以数字开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable. The value can be 0 to 256 characters in length
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Set one or more environment variables during the initialization of the EAIS instance
parameters.help_zh: 在EAIS实例初始化时设置一个或多个环境变量
parameters.name: environment_var

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the EAIS instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the EAIS instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: EAIS实例的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: eais_name

fields.help_en:
The tag key. Constraints:

The tag key cannot be empty.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.

The tag key cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

The tag key cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。限制：

不能为空。
最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. Constraints:

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.

The tag value cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

The tag value cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。限制：

最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. The list can contain up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

ElasticAcceleratedInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the EAIS instance
